problem: Application readiness aggregation is incorrectly owned by agent_core.runtime and creates the only runtime-to-rag edge. The prior B1 architecture regression also hard-codes an intermediate SCC size of 13, so a valid further reduction to 12 is incorrectly treated as a failure.

options.name: Keep readiness in Runtime and keep the exact B1 count
options.correctness: Preserves the current state but prevents cumulative architecture improvement and leaves the wrong ownership.

options.name: Move readiness to app.services and make B1 regression monotonic
options.correctness: Preserves public health behavior, removes runtime-to-rag, and ensures earlier debt reductions remain valid when later slices reduce the SCC further.
options.complexity: Six governed paths: one implementation move, one API import, two architecture tests and one responsibility record.
options.migration: Record expected-red, move readiness, update health_api, delete the old owner, and change the B1 assertion from exact 13 to no greater than 13 while keeping utils permanently absent.
options.rollback: Restore the old readiness owner, API import and exact B1 assertion.
options.verification: Both architecture tests, Architecture Gate debt delta, full Quick, lifecycle and Chromium.

options.name: Redesign all application and runtime composition
options.correctness: Could remove more cycles but mixes multiple independent boundaries.
options.migration: Introduce multiple ports and rewrite readiness, bootstrap and runtime dependencies.
options.verification: New composition contracts and release certification.

rejected_reasons.keep-boundary-and-exact-test: It blocks the overall SCC elimination goal and preserves incorrect ownership.
rejected_reasons.redesign-all-composition: It is too broad for one measurable ratchet slice.

unknowns: The remaining 12-package SCC remains open debt.
Real model certification remains outside this structural migration.
selected_responsibilities: app.services owns cross-subsystem deployment readiness aggregation.
agent_core.runtime does not depend on RAG for application health composition.
architecture regression tests assert durable removals and non-growth, not a frozen intermediate member count.
preserved_hard_invariants: utils remains outside the SCC permanently.
No Agent, transaction, capability, State or presentation behavior changes.
The debt baseline is not edited.
cutover_strategy: Create a clean expanded target before implementation, record the old 13-member state as expected-red, apply the readiness move and monotonic B1 assertion, then run complete product verification and close independently.
acceptance_claims: rag and utils are both absent from the main SCC.
The current SCC member count is 12 and cannot grow above prior verified bounds.
Readiness is owned by app.services with behavior preserved.
